challenge.description: Kita lagi nyiapake kabeh supaya sampeyan bisa nerusake.
challenge.details.body: Pamriksan sedhela iki mbantu supaya situs web tetep bisa diakses kabeh wong. Browser sampeyan nindakake petungan sethithik kanggo ngonfirmasi kunjungan iki.
challenge.details.randomx: Pamriksan sing mbutuhake CPU utawa memori luwih akeh, kayata RandomX, bakal njaluk idin sampeyan sadurunge diwiwiti. Yen ora pengin nerusake, sampeyan bisa ninggalake kaca iki.
challenge.hashwx_unsupported: Browser iki ora bisa mbukak HashWX. Dibutuhake dhukungan WebAssembly lan Web Workers.
challenge.javascript_required: Tulung aktifake JavaScript ing browser sampeyan, banjur muat maneh kaca iki.
challenge.randomx_unsupported: Browser iki ora bisa mbukak RandomX. Dibutuhake browser sing ndhukung WebAssembly, BigInt, lan Web Workers.
challenge.state.consent.description: Pamriksan iki nggunakake CPU lan memori piranti sampeyan luwih akeh tinimbang biasane. Proses iki mung diwiwiti yen sampeyan setuju nerusake.
challenge.state.consent.status: Kabeh wis siap yen sampeyan uga wis siap.
challenge.state.consent.title: Mung kari siji langkah
challenge.state.cookies.description: Situs web iki nggunakake cookie kanggo ngelingi yen browser sampeyan wis lulus pamriksan. Idini cookie kanggo situs iki, banjur coba maneh.
challenge.state.cookies.title: Cookie diblokir
challenge.state.expired.description: Pamriksan mbutuhake wektu luwih suwe tinimbang sing dikira. Miwiti pamriksan anyar bisa mbantu.
challenge.state.expired.title: Ayo dicoba sepisan maneh
challenge.state.failed.description: Kita durung bisa ngrampungake pamriksan iki. Bisa uga nyoba maneh bakal kasil.
challenge.state.failed.title: Ayo nyoba maneh
challenge.state.fast.description: Browser sampeyan lagi nindakake pamriksan cepet. Biasane proses iki rampung kanthi otomatis.
challenge.state.fast.title: Enteni sedhela
challenge.state.hashwx.description: Browser sampeyan lagi nindakake pamriksan cepet. Matur nuwun wis sabar.
challenge.state.hashwx.title: Enteni sedhela
challenge.state.initializing.description: Kita lagi nyetel pamriksan ing browser sampeyan.
challenge.state.initializing.title: Lagi nyiapake
challenge.state.limited.description: Kita wis nampa akeh panjaluk. Ngenteni sedhela bisa mbantu.
challenge.state.limited.title: Coba maneh mengko
challenge.state.network.description: Kita ora bisa nyambung menyang layanan verifikasi. Tulung priksa sambungan internet sampeyan.
challenge.state.network.title: Sambungan keganggu
challenge.state.pool.description: Kita lagi ngenteni layanan verifikasi ngonfirmasi asil pamriksan.
challenge.state.pool.title: Meh rampung
challenge.state.preparing.description: Kita lagi nyiapake kabeh supaya sampeyan bisa nerusake.
challenge.state.preparing.title: Enteni sedhela
challenge.state.randomx.description: Browser sampeyan lagi nindakake pamriksan. Tab iki bisa tetep dibukak.
challenge.state.randomx.title: Meh rampung
challenge.state.success.description: Matur nuwun wis sabar. Saiki sampeyan bisa nerusake.
challenge.state.success.title: Kabeh wis siap!
challenge.state.unavailable.description: Layanan verifikasi saiki ora kasedhiya. Tulung coba maneh sedhela mengko.
challenge.state.unavailable.title: Ana wektu tundha sedhela
challenge.state.unsupported.description: Browser iki ora ndhukung pamriksan sing dibutuhake kanggo ngakses situs web iki.
challenge.state.unsupported.title: Coba browser liyane
challenge.state.verifying.description: Browser sampeyan wis ngrampungake pamriksan. Saiki kita lagi ngonfirmasi asile.
challenge.state.verifying.title: Lagi ngrampungake
challenge.stats.label: Statistik petungan
challenge.title: Enteni sedhela
denied.description: Situs web ora bisa ngidini panjaluk iki. Yen sampeyan rumangsa iki sawijining kesalahan, tulung hubungi pangurus situs web.
denied.title: Kaca iki ora kasedhiya
error.description: Layanan verifikasi saiki ora kasedhiya. Tulung coba maneh sedhela mengko.
error.title: Ana wektu tundha sedhela
refresh.continue: Yen ora ana sing kedadeyan, terusake dhewe.
refresh.description: Kita lagi nyiapake kabeh supaya sampeyan bisa nerusake.
refresh.title: Enteni sedhela
refresh.waiting: Browser sampeyan bakal nerusake kanthi otomatis sawise {seconds} detik.
